VBO:0200839.summary: Lively, proud and independent, the Lupo Italiano tends to form close bonds with its people while remaining reserved with strangers. Its association describes a versatile search dog that follows ground trails and scent carried on the air, including in mountain rescue. Mario Messi began developing the population in 1966.
VBO:0200839.shortDescription: A lively, independent Italian search dog, closely attached to its people and used for ground and air scent work.

sources.title: AAALI — Standard di Razza
sources.evidence: Own maintained normative standard describes lively, proud, independent character and strong attachment. Search use includes mountain rescue and persons/ injured wildlife. Complete adult morphology directly read, including male60–70/female58–65cm, clean head, medium parallel erect ears, golden oblique eyes, robust not-too-long level body, strong dry legs/oval feet, medium doublecoat and rather long low hanging tail at rest/alert. Extreme resistance, health, protection/safety, therapy suitability, wolf-genetic causation and learning rankings excluded.

sources.title: AAALI — Storia e Caratteristiche del Lupo Italiano
sources.evidence: Own association founding account names Mario Messi and1966 start; describes close affection and reserve with strangers, mountain/person search using ground trails and especially air scent. Wolf/GSD ancestry and fortunate-genetics origin story are not used as proof or transferable traits; no endurance/health/suitability guarantees.
